releaseNotes: High-Accuracy GPS Engine: Replaced coarse cell-tower fallbacks with progressive satellite convergence (sub-25m precision)
Continuous GPS Hardware Warming: Active background satellite stream prevents cold-start location lock delays on task start
Adaptive Geofencing & DOP: Dynamically accounts for indoor signal attenuation and structural interference
On-Site Weak Signal Override: Field representatives are never blocked when cellular data is weak at clinic facilities
Real-Time Satellite Quality Badges: Live satellite signal status (Satellite, Good, Indoor) displayed during task verification
